description: List your text conversations, most recent activity first. Each entry has phone (the other party, or a group's members joined by commas), last_message, last_direction, last_at, message_count, thread_type (direct or group), thread_ref, and the device it is on. Use get_conversation to read one in full.

limit.description: How many conversations to return, 1 to 200. Default 20.

view.description: Which folder to list. all: everything except archived and spam (default). inbox: conversations where the other side has replied. outbox: nothing has come back yet. archived and spam: those folders only.

name: list_conversations
title: List conversations
